Escape the other crowded boats and join us instead. Our snorkel guides are some of the best on the island and they are extremely excited to share some turtle time with you. 50 minute in-water snorkel time. Our tour takes our guests along the beautiful coast of Waikiki, where we anchor at the well-known snorkel location called Turtle Canyon.
